title: US Dollar falls to R$ 5.14 and stocks rally on market relief
seoTitle: Dollar drops to R$ 5.14 on global market relief
subtitle: The US currency hits its lowest level in over 10 days, and the Ibovespa ends the week in positive territory.
excerpt: The US dollar closed at R$ 5.14 following a day of relief in domestic and foreign markets. The Brazilian stock market surged nearly 2%.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The US dollar closed at R$ 5.14, hitting its lowest level in just over 10 days. The greenback's decline came amid a day of relief across both domestic and international markets.

The day's positive momentum was also reflected in the stock market's performance. The benchmark index ended the session up nearly 2%, managing to close the week in positive territory.

With information from Agência Brasil.
